Done when all five elements are present in the report
verify: Read the report for the five required elements
Pass when all five elements appear in the report

steps.title: Reconcile the reported figures to the booked reserves and paid amounts
sop: Compare the reported excess amount to the booked reserve on the claim
Investigate and record any difference before distribution
Done when the reconciliation is recorded
verify: Read the reconciliation for unexplained differences
Pass when the reported excess reconciles to the booked reserve

steps.title: Distribute the report to claims leadership and actuarial
sop: Send the report to claims leadership and to the actuarial function
Record the distribution list and the send date on the claim
Done when the distribution is recorded with actuarial included
verify: Read the distribution list for the actuarial recipient
Pass when actuarial appears on the recorded distribution list

steps.title: Notify reinsurers and excess markets in the same cycle
sop: Issue the excess-judgment notification to every attaching market
Record the notification dates against the ceded record
Done when every market has a recorded notification in the cycle
verify: Compare notification dates to the report distribution date
Pass when every market notification falls in the same reporting cycle

steps.title: Record the report date and distribution list on the claim
sop: Enter the report date and the full distribution list on the claim
Index the report document under the claim
Done when the report is filed with its date and list
verify: Open the claim document list and locate the report
Pass when the filed report carries a date and a distribution list

steps.title: Confirm actuarial acknowledgment for reserve and IBNR impact
sop: Request confirmation that actuarial has taken the event into their review
Record the acknowledgment on the claim
Done when the actuarial acknowledgment is recorded
verify: Read the claim for an actuarial acknowledgment entry
Pass when an actuarial acknowledgment is recorded on the claim

generic.Defined scope/population: Responses to tender-of-limits demands due on this claim
generic.In-scope period: From demand receipt to the stated response deadline
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Response type, tender conditions, reasoning, approval record, delivery proof
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Responses issued equal the tender-of-limits demands received
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Response stored with its send date and delivery proof on the claim
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Responses issued inside two days of the deadline logged with the reason
generic.Test population: All tender-of-limits demands received in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every response is filed with a send date before the deadline
generic.Exception handling path: An approval not obtained in time escalates rather than transmitting unapproved
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A tender of limits is unconditional and releases all insureds
generic.Evidence location: Response and delivery proof on the claim in the claim file repository

steps.title: Confirm the response deadline and set the two-day target
sop: Read the stated demand deadline from the demand log
Set the internal target two business days before that deadline
Done when the internal target date is recorded
verify: Compare the target date to the stated deadline
Pass when the target sits at least two business days before the deadline

steps.title: Make any tender unconditional and covering all insureds
sop: Where tendering, state the tender without conditions attached
Confirm the release sought covers every named insured
Done when the tender wording is unconditional and covers all insureds
verify: Read the tender wording for conditions and release scope
Pass when the tender is unconditional and names all insureds

steps.title: State the reasoning and any counter-offer in the same response
sop: Where rejecting or countering, state the reasoning from the evaluation memo
Include any counter-offer figure in the same response
Done when the reasoning and any counter appear together
verify: Read the response for stated reasoning where it rejects or counters
Pass when every rejection or counter carries stated reasoning

steps.title: Obtain the required approval before transmission
sop: Compare the response position to the authority required
Obtain the approval and record it before transmitting
Done when the approval is recorded before transmission
verify: Compare the approval date to the response transmission date
Pass when the approval record predates the response transmission

steps.title: Transmit by a trackable method and file the delivery proof
sop: Transmit the response by a trackable delivery method
File the response and its delivery proof on the claim
Done when the response and proof are filed with a send date
verify: Compare the send date to the demand deadline
Pass when the response was sent before the demand deadline

steps.title: Reconcile responses issued against demands received
sop: Compare the demand log to the responses filed on the claim
Log any demand without a response as an exception with an action
Done when the reconciliation is recorded
verify: Read the reconciliation for demands without a filed response
Pass when every tender-of-limits demand has a filed response
